    "My purchases have mostly solved specific connection or accessory needs. Smart speakers, streaming players and a doorbell do not solve those needs, so I would skip them.",

    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in almost any electronic device.",
    "Several streaming and Alexa devices repeat the same assumption that I want home entertainment or smart home equipment, although my purchases give little reason to expect that."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection across my WiFi adapter, USB expansion card, DVI cable and Ethernet adapter is their practical purpose: connecting equipment or adding a needed port.",
    "My latest purchase addressed network connectivity, which is more relevant to my current interests than a general interest in gadgets.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and tied to particular needs. I need a clear reason to buy something now, rather than a possibility that it might be useful someday."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed that I buy specific accessories to solve practical equipment needs."
}
